boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named cultural destinations on corridors bordering SLU’s Midtown/Grand Center orbit, each with a documented reason to go.

cards.title: Contemporary Art Museum St. Louis
cards.subtitle: Washington Boulevard corridor, near SLU
cards.notes: Use Washington Boulevard for a no-ticket gallery visit; check the museum’s current exhibitions and visitor policies before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Contemporary art galleries with free entry.
cards.evidence_claim: CAM is at 3750 Washington Boulevard and states that admission is free with no ticket required.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit — Contemporary Art Museum St. Louis
cards.access_notes: Wednesday–Sunday hours are listed on the visitor page; closed Monday and Tuesday.

cards.title: Pulitzer Arts Foundation
cards.subtitle: Washington Boulevard corridor, near SLU
cards.notes: Plan a gallery stop around the listed Thursday–Sunday hours, then use the outdoor campus or nearby Washington Boulevard bike racks.
cards.short_summary: Free contemporary-art museum and outdoor campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pulitzer, at 3716 Washington Boulevard, states that museum admission and adjacent-lot parking are free.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Thursday–Sunday; the outdoor campus is open daily from sunrise to sunset.

cards.title: The Sheldon
cards.subtitle: Washington Boulevard corridor, near SLU
cards.notes: Check the calendar for a concert or visit during listed gallery hours; use the venue’s accessibility and parking guidance when planning.
cards.short_summary: Historic concert hall with a public art gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sheldon at 3648 Washington Boulevard identifies itself as a concert hall, art gallery, arts educator, and historic venue.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are Wednesday–Friday and Saturday; performances and tickets vary by event.

cards.title: Jazz St. Louis
cards.subtitle: Washington Avenue corridor at Grand Boulevard
cards.notes: Look for an all-ages concert on the schedule and reserve directly through the box office; food is optional and separately charged.
cards.short_summary: All-ages jazz performances at the Ferring Jazz Bistro.
cards.evidence_claim: Jazz St. Louis says its Steward Center for Jazz is at 3536 Washington Avenue at Grand Boulevard and is an all-ages venue.
cards.access_notes: Box office hours are Tuesday–Friday, plus two hours before shows; individual event admission may be required.

cards.title: High Low
cards.subtitle: Washington Avenue corridor, near SLU
cards.notes: Drop in during café hours to browse the library and public gallery, or consult the venue calendar for literary and performance events.
cards.short_summary: Literary arts café with library, gallery, and listening room.
cards.evidence_claim: High Low is a Kranzberg Arts Foundation literary arts café at 3301 Washington Avenue; its gallery is public during café hours.
cards.access_notes: The venue lists café and gallery access daily from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.; events may have separate admission.

cards.title: The Grandel
cards.subtitle: Grandel Square corridor off Washington Boulevard
cards.notes: Check the event calendar before walking over, then choose a concert, play, dance performance, comedy show, or other listed program.
cards.short_summary: Historic multi-use theater and arts facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The Grandel at 3610 Grandel Square is a multi-use arts facility with a theater presenting concerts, plays, musicals, dance, and comedy.
cards.access_notes: Open for select shows and programming only; consult the venue calendar before visiting.

cards.title: The Kranzberg
cards.subtitle: North Grand Boulevard corridor, near SLU
cards.notes: Aim for Saturday afternoon to see the public gallery without an appointment, or check programming for performances in its theater and studio.
cards.short_summary: Black-box theater, studio, and public gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kranzberg at 501 N. Grand Boulevard contains a black-box theater, studio performance space, and gallery; its gallery is public Saturdays noon–4 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Gallery access is Saturdays, noon–4 p.m., no appointment necessary; performance admission varies.

cards.title: .ZACK
cards.subtitle: Locust Street corridor, near SLU
cards.notes: Use the events calendar to find a performance in the resident theater; the building’s named address makes it an easy Locust Street waypoint.
cards.short_summary: Multi-use arts facility in the historic Cadillac building.
cards.evidence_claim: .ZACK is a 40,000-square-foot Kranzberg Arts Foundation multi-use arts facility in the historic Cadillac building at 3224 Locust Street.
cards.access_notes: Programming and public access vary by event; dedicated and metered parking are described by the venue.

cards.title: The MOTO Museum
cards.subtitle: Locust Street corridor, near SLU
cards.notes: Visit during Tuesday–Friday public hours to see the vintage motorcycle collection; confirm first if a private event may affect access.
cards.short_summary: Free museum of rare and vintage motorcycles.
cards.evidence_claim: The MOTO Museum lists free admission, Tuesday–Friday public hours, and a collection of more than 75 vintage motorcycles at 3408 Locust Street.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; private events can affect public visiting hours.

cards.entity_name: Powell Hall at the Jack C. Taylor Music Center
cards.title: Powell Hall
cards.subtitle: North Grand Boulevard corridor, near SLU
cards.notes: Browse the orchestra’s current calendar for an age-appropriate concert, then use the venue page for transit, parking, and accessibility details.
cards.short_summary: Renovated home of the St. Louis Symphony Orchestra.
cards.evidence_claim: Powell Hall at the Jack C. Taylor Music Center is the St. Louis Symphony Orchestra’s venue at 718 N. Grand Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Powell Hall at the Jack C. Taylor Music Center — St. Louis Symphony Orchestra
cards.access_notes: Concerts require tickets unless a specific event says otherwise; parking and accessibility information are provided by the venue.
